Nothing reviewed was missing from either: the digest reports on WHICH COIN arrived - bonding or graduated, with or without a banner - not on whether the provider changed anything, which is the exact disease the discovery_coins v3 review documents for pages. The document review stays in the repo untouched for what it certifies (one exact observed document); this review is what a per-coin watch tap can actually be gated by. REVIEWED MATERIAL: the three named coin-v2 documents above, one bonding and two graduated, 52 distinct leaf lines between them, every one already inside the discovery_coins v3 listing. THE LEAF SETS ARE INHERITED VERBATIM from row_projection_discovery_coins v3 (31 required, 36 optional, recomputed there over 44 live /coins bodies and 2434 rows): /coins-v2 serves the same provider coin record as /coins rows, all three documents promote under the inherited split, and three documents of route-local material must not out-vote 2434 rows of the same record family. A leaf is required here only if the normalizer reads it and it was present on every row of every body either review has looked at; everything else observed anywhere is in the CLOSED optional set, so a leaf nobody has reviewed still refuses the document rather than being silently projected away. EXPECTED EARLY REFUSALS, stated so they read as findings and not faults: a coin-v2 document for a rarer coin may omit an inherited required leaf this route was never measured to omit; the amendment path is the discovery review's - read the named acquisition in the retained bytes, decide on that evidence, move the leaf, and write the move down here. MEASURED SEMANTICS THIS LISTING DOES NOT CARRY: market_cap_usd and usd_market_cap both assert one quantity and disagree on every reviewed document - Dregg 382986.57 vs 384371.17 (0.36 percent) and OpenSolve 58025.91 vs 58368.08 (0.59 percent), read back from the exact retained bytes, with the source audit having seen the same pair diverge up to 9 percent elsewhere; both are required leaves and neither may be preferred, reconciled or averaged, here or downstream. The reserve quartet goes stale on graduation: a complete=true coin keeps its launch constants while its market cap moves, so reserves on this route are NOT price-bearing for a graduated coin and crate::reserves refuses to assemble them. updated_at ALONE is epoch seconds while every other timestamp is epoch milliseconds. This review was made by an agent, not by Ember. It authorises retaining and normalizing provider-asserted identity strings and numbers as provider assertions only; it certifies no price, no executability and no on-chain fact.
